factor_scores.evidence_summary: Nonce/request hashes and `crosschainRequestConfirmation` reject replayed source requests.
factor_scores.evidence_detail: `nonce()` is based on request hash array length; `_addRequest` stores unique hashes; `confirmCrosschainRequest` requires `crosschainRequestConfirmation[srcHash] == bytes32(0)` before minting.
